description: Log-streaming-only insights: workflow lifecycle overview, cancelled executions, per-project failure breakdown, audit trail (workflow config changes + user activity), node type usage, and queue/worker health (queue mode only).

panels.description: Cancelled executions.
panels.title: Cancelled Executions

panels.description: Share of completed executions that were cancelled rather than succeeding or failing.
panels.title: Cancellation Rate

panels.description: Count of audit events (workflow config changes and user actions) in the selected time range. When a workflow is selected above, shows only audit events for that workflow. User login events have no workflow context so they only appear under All.
panels.title: Audit Events

panels.description: Queue jobs where the worker became unresponsive mid-execution. The queue auto-retries stalled jobs but the original execution attempt is lost. Any non-zero value warrants investigation. Only fires in queue mode.
panels.title: Stalled Jobs

panels.description: Executions started minus completed (success, failed, or cancelled) in the selected time range. A persistently positive number indicates workflows that started but never finished — check for stuck or very long-running executions.
panels.title: In-Flight Executions

panels.description: Failed login attempts in the selected time range. Repeated failures may indicate a credential attack or a misconfigured SSO client.
panels.title: Failed Login Attempts

panels.description: All four workflow lifecycle events in one view. Started that exceed success+failed+cancelled indicates stuck or long-running executions. Spikes in failed without matching started spikes suggest retries or queue-level failures.
panels.title: Workflow Events Over Time

panels.description: n8n cancels an execution when a user manually stops it or when the workflow's "On new execution" policy stops a running one.
panels.title: Cancellations Over Time

panels.description: Failed executions grouped by project and workflow. Click any row to filter the entire dashboard to that workflow — all panels below (Recent Failures, Raw Logs, etc.) will update.

targets.expr: topk(20, sum by (project_name, workflow_name, last_node) (count_over_time({job="n8n-log-streaming", event_name="n8n.workflow.failed", workflow_name=~"$workflow_name", workflow_id=~"$workflow_id"} | json project_name="payload.projectName", last_node="payload.lastNodeExecuted" [$__range])))

panels.title: Failed Executions by Project & Workflow

panels.description: Click any log line to expand the full JSON event — includes executionId, workflowName, projectName, and the actual error message. Metrics only give counts; logs give the failure detail.
panels.title: Recent Workflow Failures

panels.description: Expand each line to see which workflow was cancelled, the executionId, and the trigger mode.
panels.title: Recent Cancelled Executions

panels.description: How many times each node completed execution, broken down by workflow. "Node Name" is the label given to that step in the workflow editor (e.g. "Call CHEFS API"). "Node Type" is the n8n integration category (e.g. n8n-nodes-base.httpRequest = HTTP Request). High counts on a single node reveal which external services are called most — Helps identify which integrations are used most frequently.

targets.expr: topk(30, sum by (node_name, node_type, workflow_name) (count_over_time({job="n8n-log-streaming", event_name="n8n.node.finished", workflow_name=~"$workflow_name", workflow_id=~"$workflow_id"} | json node_name="payload.nodeName", node_type="payload.nodeType" [$__range])))

panels.title: Most Active Nodes

panels.description: Workflow CRUD changes over time — created, deleted, activated, deactivated, updated. Useful for correlating execution behaviour changes with config edits.
panels.title: Workflow Configuration Changes

panels.description: Login success/failure, signups, and account deletions.
panels.title: User Activity

panels.description: Raw audit events — expand each line to see who made the change, which workflow was affected, and when.
panels.title: Audit Log

panels.description: Filter all log-streaming events by workflow, project, event type, and trigger mode using the dropdowns above.
panels.title: Raw Logs

panels.description: Queue job lifecycle — only fires when n8n runs in queue mode. No data here means the instance is in regular single-process mode.
panels.title: Queue Job Events (Queue Mode Only)

panels.description: Worker process lifecycle. A stopped event not followed by a started event means a worker went down and did not recover.
panels.title: Worker Events (Queue Mode Only)

panels.description: Failed workflow executions in the selected time range.
panels.title: Failed Executions

panels.description: Percentage of completed executions that failed. Elevated values indicate a systemic problem rather than isolated workflow bugs.
panels.title: Failure Rate

panels.description: Most common failure error messages grouped by workflow. The same message appearing across multiple workflows points to a shared dependency (e.g. an external API down) rather than isolated bugs.

targets.expr: topk(20, sum by (workflow_name, error_message) (count_over_time({job="n8n-log-streaming", event_name="n8n.workflow.failed", workflow_name=~"$workflow_name", workflow_id=~"$workflow_id"} | json error_message="payload.errorMessage" [$__range])))

panels.title: Top Error Messages
